table.name: TLGNR_MAP_KVGR5_DISTRIBDEST_BS
table.description: Mapping for Business Partner KVGR5 (customer group 5) into Distribution Destination during SAP import BP. Examples: S01 - OUT, S02 - IUD, S03 - IUP, S04 - INB.

column.name: MAP_KVGR5_DISTRIBDEST_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. S01, S02, S03, ...

column.name: DISTRIBUTION_DEST_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_distribution_dest_bs. Code of the distribution destination distinguished by Logon. OUT, IUD, IUP, ...

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
